quotes.originalText: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
quotes.translation: Raise yourself up by your own self; never let yourself sink down. For the self alone is its own ally, and the self alone is its own adversary.

quotes.originalText: असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्। अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
quotes.translation: Without question, O strong-armed one, the mind is fickle and hard to rein in. Yet it is brought under control, O Kaunteya, by steady practice and by letting go.

quotes.originalText: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते॥
quotes.translation: Rooted in yoga, carry out your work, O Dhananjaya, letting go of attachment. Stay the same whether you succeed or fail — this evenness of mind is what yoga means.

quotes.originalText: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता। योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः॥
quotes.translation: A lamp sheltered from the wind does not waver: that is the image given for the yogi whose mind is mastered, absorbed in the discipline of the Self.

quotes.originalText: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्। तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी॥
quotes.translation: Waters pour into the ocean, which is ever filling yet stays unmoved in its depths. The one into whom all desires flow in the same way finds peace; not the one who chases after desires.

quotes.originalText: बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्। स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते॥
quotes.translation: Unattached to contact with outer things, one discovers the joy that lies within the Self. Joined to Brahman through yoga, such a person tastes a happiness that never fades.

quotes.originalText: शनैः शनैरुपरमेद्बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया। आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्॥
quotes.translation: Little by little, let the mind come to rest, guided by a steady and resolute intellect. Once the mind is settled in the Self, think of nothing at all.

quotes.originalText: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना। न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्॥
quotes.translation: One who is not steadied has no clear understanding and no power of contemplation. Without contemplation there is no peace, and without peace, where could happiness come from?

quotes.originalText: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
quotes.translation: Whenever the fickle, wavering mind strays, wherever it goes, draw it back from there and bring it under the guidance of the Self.

quotes.originalText: जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः। शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः॥
quotes.translation: When someone has mastered themselves and is deeply at peace, the highest Self stays collected within them — through cold and heat, pleasure and pain, praise and insult alike.

quotes.originalText: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः॥
quotes.translation: Your own path, even followed imperfectly, is better than another's followed well. Better to die walking your own path; another's path brings only danger.

quotes.originalText: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च। वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्॥
quotes.translation: I dwell within the heart of every being. From Me arise memory and knowledge, and their loss as well. I alone am what all the Vedas seek to know; I am the author of Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas.

quotes.originalText: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना। अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे॥
quotes.translation: Some perceive the Self within the self through meditation, others through the path of knowledge, and still others through the path of selfless action.

quotes.originalText: योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः॥
quotes.translation: Yoga is the stilling of the movements of the mind.

quotes.originalText: तदा द्रष्टुः स्वरूपेऽवस्थानम्॥
quotes.translation: Then the one who sees rests in its own essential form.

quotes.originalText: अभ्यासवैराग्याभ्यां तन्निरोधः॥
quotes.translation: These movements are stilled through steady practice and letting go.

quotes.originalText: स तु दीर्घकालनैरन्तर्यसत्कारासेवितो दृढभूमिः॥
quotes.translation: Practice takes firm root when it is kept up over a long time, without gaps, and with reverent care.

quotes.originalText: मैत्रीकरुणामुदितोपेक्षाणां सुखदुःखपुण्यापुण्यविषयाणां भावनातश्चित्तप्रसादनम्॥
quotes.translation: The mind grows clear and calm through meeting the happy with friendliness, the suffering with compassion, the good with gladness, and the wrongdoer with even-minded acceptance.

quotes.originalText: स्थिरसुखमासनम्॥
quotes.translation: A seated posture should be stable and at ease.

quotes.originalText: तत्र प्रत्ययैकतानता ध्यानम्॥
quotes.translation: Meditation (dhyana) is when awareness flows toward that one point, unbroken, as a single stream.

quotes.originalText: विशोका वा ज्योतिष्मती॥
quotes.translation: Or the mind is steadied by dwelling on the radiant inner light that is free from sorrow.

quotes.originalText: तपःस्वाध्यायेश्वरप्रणिधानानि क्रियायोगः॥
quotes.translation: Disciplined effort, study of oneself, and offering oneself to Ishvara — together these make up the yoga of practice.

quotes.originalText: वितर्कबाधने प्रतिपक्षभावनम्॥
quotes.translation: When troubling thoughts take hold, deliberately turn the mind toward their opposite.

quotes.originalText: आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु। बुद्धिं तु सारथिं विद्धि मनः प्रग्रहमेव च॥
quotes.translation: Know the Self as the rider of the chariot, and the body as the chariot. Know the intellect as the charioteer, and the mind as the reins.

quotes.originalText: ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत्। तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम्॥
quotes.translation: All this — whatever moves in this moving world — is pervaded by the Lord. Enjoy through renunciation. Do not covet the wealth of anyone.

quotes.originalText: नान्तःप्रज्ञं न बहिष्प्रज्ञं नोभयतःप्रज्ञं न प्रज्ञानघनं न प्रज्ञं नाप्रज्ञम्। अदृष्टमव्यवहार्यमग्राह्यमलक्षणमचिन्त्यमव्यपदेश्यमेकात्मप्रत्ययसारं प्रपञ्चोपशमं शान्तं शिवमद्वैतं चतुर्थं मन्यन्ते स आत्मा स विज्ञेयः॥
quotes.translation: The fourth state is aware neither of the inner world nor of the outer, nor of both together. It is no dense mass of awareness, neither knowing nor unknowing. It cannot be seen or handled, grasped or defined, thought about or named. Its essence is the single certainty of the Self; in it the world of appearances falls quiet. It is tranquil, auspicious, without a second. That is the Self — that is what must be realized.

quotes.originalText: द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परिषस्वजाते। तयोरन्यः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वत्त्यनश्नन्नन्यो अभिचाकशीति॥
quotes.translation: Two birds, inseparable companions, perch upon the same tree. One eats the sweet fruit while the other looks on without eating.

quotes.originalText: तत्त्वमसि॥
quotes.translation: Thou art That.

quotes.originalText: अणोरणीयान्महतो महीयानात्मास्य जन्तोर्निहितो गुहायाम्। तमक्रतुः पश्यति वीतशोको धातुप्रसादान्महिमानमात्मनः॥
quotes.translation: The Self, smaller than the smallest and greater than the greatest, is hidden in the heart of every creature. One who is free from desire and free from grief, with a serene mind, sees the glory of the Self.

quotes.originalText: मनसैवानुद्रष्टव्यं नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन। मृत्योः स मृत्युमाप्नोति य इह नानेव पश्यति॥
quotes.translation: It is to be perceived by the mind alone — there is no diversity here whatsoever. One who sees diversity here goes from death to death.

quotes.originalText: प्रणवो धनुः शरो ह्यात्मा ब्रह्म तल्लक्ष्यमुच्यते। अप्रमत्तेन वेद्धव्यं शरवत्तन्मयो भवेत्॥
quotes.translation: Om is the bow, the Self is the arrow, Brahman is the target. It is to be hit by the undistracted. One should become one with it, as the arrow becomes one with the target.

quotes.originalText: यो वै भूमा तत्सुखम्। नाल्पे सुखमस्ति। भूमैव सुखम्॥
quotes.translation: That which is infinite — that alone is happiness. There is no happiness in the finite. The Infinite alone is happiness.

quotes.originalText: असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। मृत्योर्मामृतं गमय॥
quotes.translation: Lead me from the unreal to the real. Lead me from darkness to light. Lead me from death to immortality.

quotes.originalText: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः। न हि सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः॥
quotes.translation: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by wishful thinking. Deer do not walk into the mouth of a sleeping lion.

quotes.originalText: विद्या मित्रं प्रवासेषु भार्या मित्रं गृहेषु च। व्याधितस्यौषधं मित्रं धर्मो मित्रं मृतस्य च॥
quotes.translation: Knowledge is a friend in travels, a wife is a friend at home, medicine is a friend to the sick, and dharma is a friend after death.

quotes.originalText: क्षणशः कणशश्चैव विद्यामर्थं च साधयेत्। क्षणत्यागे कुतो विद्या कणत्यागे कुतो धनम्॥
quotes.translation: One should pursue knowledge moment by moment, and wealth grain by grain. If moments are wasted, how can there be knowledge? If grains are neglected, how can there be wealth?

quotes.originalText: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः। सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु मा कश्चित् दुःखभाग्भवेत्॥
quotes.translation: May all be happy, may all be free from illness. May all see auspiciousness, may none suffer.

quotes.originalText: परोपकाराय फलन्ति वृक्षाः परोपकाराय वहन्ति नद्यः। परोपकाराय दुहन्ति गावः परोपकारार्थमिदं शरीरम्॥
quotes.translation: Trees bear fruit for others, rivers flow for others, cows give milk for others — this body too is meant for the service of others.

quotes.originalText: शान्तितुल्यं तपो नास्ति न सन्तोषात्परं सुखम्। न तृष्णायाः परो व्याधिर्न च धर्मो दयापरः॥
quotes.translation: There is no austerity equal to peace of mind, no happiness greater than contentment, no disease worse than greed, and no dharma higher than compassion.

quotes.originalText: अयं निजः परो वेति गणना लघुचेतसाम्। उदारचरितानां तु वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्॥
quotes.translation: This one is mine, that one is a stranger — such is the reckoning of the narrow-minded. For the noble-hearted, the entire world is one family.

quotes.originalText: गुणा गुणज्ञेषु गुणा भवन्ति ते निर्गुणं प्राप्य भवन्ति दोषाः। सुस्वादुतोयाः प्रभवन्ति नद्यः समुद्रमासाद्य भवन्त्यपेयाः॥
quotes.translation: Virtues are appreciated as virtues by those who understand them; among the ignorant they become faults. Rivers flow with sweet water, but upon reaching the ocean become undrinkable.

quotes.originalText: विद्या ददाति विनयं विनयाद्याति पात्रताम्। पात्रत्वाद्धनमाप्नोति धनाद्धर्मं ततः सुखम्॥
quotes.translation: Knowledge gives humility, from humility comes worthiness, from worthiness comes wealth, from wealth comes dharma, and from dharma comes happiness.

quotes.originalText: मनसि वचसि काये पुण्यपीयूषपूर्णास्त्रिभुवनमुपकारश्रेणिभिः प्रीणयन्तः। परगुणपरमाणून् पर्वतीकृत्य नित्यं निजहृदि विकसन्तः सन्ति सन्तः कियन्तः॥
quotes.translation: Filled with the nectar of virtue in mind, speech, and body, delighting the three worlds with their benevolent deeds, magnifying the smallest virtues of others — how rare are such noble souls whose hearts bloom thus!

quotes.originalText: धर्म एव हतो हन्ति धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः। तस्माद्धर्मो न हन्तव्यो मा नो धर्मो हतोऽवधीत्॥
quotes.translation: Dharma destroyed destroys; dharma protected protects. So dharma must never be destroyed, lest dharma, destroyed, destroy us.

quotes.originalText: न कश्चित्कस्यचिन्मित्रं न कश्चित्कस्यचिद्रिपुः। व्यवहारेण मित्राणि जायन्ते रिपवस्तथा॥
quotes.translation: No one is born a friend, no one is born an enemy. By conduct and interaction, friendships and enmities arise.

quotes.originalText: मणिर्लुण्ठति पादेषु काचः शिरसि धार्यते। क्रयविक्रयवेलायां काचः काचो मणिर्मणिः॥
quotes.translation: A gem may roll about at one's feet while glass is worn on the head; but when it comes to buying and selling, glass is glass and a gem is a gem.

quotes.originalText: धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः। धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
quotes.translation: Patience, forgiveness, self-control, non-stealing, purity, mastery over the senses, wisdom, knowledge, truthfulness, and freedom from anger — these ten are the marks of dharma.

quotes.originalText: यथा ह्येकेन चक्रेण न रथस्य गतिर्भवेत्। एवं पुरुषकारेण विना दैवं न सिध्यति॥
quotes.translation: Just as a chariot cannot move on a single wheel, so too destiny cannot bring results without human effort.

quotes.originalText: बुद्धिर्यस्य बलं तस्य निर्बुद्धेस्तु कुतो बलम्। वने सिंहो मदोन्मत्तः शशकेन निपातितः॥
quotes.translation: Strength belongs to one who has wisdom; where is strength for the one without wisdom? A lion maddened by pride in the forest was brought down by a hare.

quotes.originalText: रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मः साधुः सत्यपराक्रमः। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानां मघवानिव॥
quotes.translation: Rama is dharma in bodily form — good, and true in his valour. He is king of the whole world, as Indra is among the gods.

quotes.originalText: उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम्। सोत्साहस्यास्ति लोकेऽस्मिन् न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम्॥
quotes.translation: Enthusiasm is the greatest strength, O noble one. There is no power greater than enthusiasm. For one who is enthusiastic, nothing in this world is impossible.

quotes.originalText: अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलमनिर्वेदः परं सुखम्। अनिर्वेदो हि सततं सर्वार्थेषु प्रवर्तकः॥
quotes.translation: Not losing heart is the root of success; not losing heart is the highest happiness. It is steady, undaunted spirit that keeps every endeavour moving forward.

quotes.originalText: सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्यं पद्माश्रिता सदा। सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम्॥
quotes.translation: Truth alone is sovereign in the world; in truth Lakshmi always makes her home. Everything has its root in truth, and there is no state higher than truth.

quotes.originalText: सत्यं च धर्मं च पराक्रमं च भूतानुकम्पां प्रियवादितां च। द्विजातिदेवातिथिपूजनं च पन्थानमाहुस्त्रिदिवस्य सन्तः॥
quotes.translation: Truth, dharma, valor, compassion for all beings, sweet speech, and the worship of sages, gods, and guests — the noble ones say these are the path to heaven.

quotes.originalText: धर्मादर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात्प्रभवते सुखम्। धर्मेण लभते सर्वं धर्मसारमिदं जगत्॥
quotes.translation: From dharma comes prosperity, and from dharma comes happiness. Through dharma one gains everything; dharma is the very essence of this world.

quotes.originalText: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन् सततं प्रियवादिनः। अप्रियस्य तु पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः॥
quotes.translation: People who always say what is pleasant are easy to find, O king. But one who speaks an unwelcome truth for your good — and one who will listen to it — are rare.

quotes.originalText: तद्ब्रूहि वचनं देवि राज्ञो यदभिकाङ्क्षितम्। करिष्ये प्रतिजाने च रामो द्विर्नाभिभाषते॥
quotes.translation: Tell me, my queen, what the king desires. I will do it — I give you my word. Rama does not speak twice.

quotes.originalText: सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद्व्रतं मम॥
quotes.translation: To anyone who comes to me even once and asks, saying 'I am yours', I grant freedom from fear of every being. This is my vow.

quotes.originalText: सत्यमेवानृशंसं च राजवृत्तं सनातनम्। तस्मात्सत्यात्मकं राज्यं सत्ये लोकः प्रतिष्ठितः॥
quotes.translation: Truth and kindness are the timeless conduct of a king. So a kingdom must be founded on truth, for the world itself stands on truth.

quotes.originalText: एको धर्मः परं श्रेयः क्षमैका शान्तिरुत्तमा। विद्यैका परमा दृष्टिरहिंसैका सुखावहा॥
quotes.translation: Dharma alone is the highest good; forbearance alone is the greatest peace. Knowledge alone is the clearest vision, and non-violence alone brings happiness.

quotes.originalText: अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाहिंसा परो दमः। अहिंसा परमं दानमहिंसा परमस्तपः॥
quotes.translation: Non-violence is the highest dharma; non-violence is the highest self-restraint. Non-violence is the highest gift, and non-violence the highest austerity.

quotes.originalText: न सा सभा यत्र न सन्ति वृद्धा न ते वृद्धा ये न वदन्ति धर्मम्। नासौ धर्मो यत्र न सत्यमस्ति न तत्सत्यं यच्छलेनानुविद्धम्॥
quotes.translation: It is no assembly where there are no elders; they are no elders who do not speak for dharma. It is no dharma where there is no truth, and it is no truth that is shot through with deceit.

quotes.originalText: नास्ति विद्यासमं चक्षुर्नास्ति विद्यासमं तपः। नास्ति रागसमं दुःखं नास्ति त्यागसमं सुखम्॥
quotes.translation: There is no eye like knowledge and no austerity like knowledge. There is no sorrow like attachment, and no happiness like letting go.

quotes.originalText: न तत्परस्य संदध्यात्प्रतिकूलं यदात्मनः। संग्रहेणैष धर्मः स्यात्कामादन्यः प्रवर्तते॥
quotes.translation: Do not do to another what you would find hurtful to yourself. That, in brief, is dharma; whatever else people do springs from desire.

quotes.originalText: अक्रोधेन जयेत्क्रोधमसाधुं साधुना जयेत्। जयेत्कदर्यं दानेन जयेत्सत्येन चानृतम्॥
quotes.translation: Overcome anger with calm, and the unkind with kindness. Overcome the miser with generosity, and falsehood with truth.

quotes.originalText: षड् दोषाः पुरुषेणेह हातव्या भूतिमिच्छता। निद्रा तन्द्री भयं क्रोध आलस्यं दीर्घसूत्रता॥
quotes.translation: Whoever seeks to flourish should give up six faults: too much sleep, drowsiness, fear, anger, idleness, and putting things off.

quotes.originalText: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मः क्षमा च परमं बलम्। आत्मज्ञानं परं ज्ञानं न सत्याद्विद्यते परम्॥
quotes.translation: Kindness is the highest dharma, and forbearance the greatest strength. Knowledge of the Self is the highest knowledge, and nothing stands above truth.

quotes.originalText: सत्यस्य वचनं श्रेयः सत्यादपि हितं भवेत्। यद्भूतहितमत्यन्तमेतत्सत्यं मतं मम॥
quotes.translation: Speaking the truth is good, but speaking what helps is better still. What brings the greatest good to all beings — that, I hold, is truth.

quotes.originalText: नित्यं क्रोधात्तपो रक्षेच्छ्रियं रक्षेत मत्सरात्। विद्यां मानावमानाभ्यामात्मानं तु प्रमादतः॥
quotes.translation: Always guard your discipline from anger and your fortune from envy; guard your learning from pride and slight, and guard yourself from carelessness.
